name: Betting
description: Create and track bets with other league members

commands.name: betcreate
commands.description: Create a bet with another member
commands.longDescription: Create a custom bet with another league member. Both parties must accept for the bet to be active.

examples.input: /betcreate betuser:@Nixon description:"My team beats yours Week 10" amount:500
examples.output:
📝 Bet Created!
AJ Boorde vs Nixon Ball
Stakes: 🪙 500 each
Terms: My team beats yours Week 10

Waiting for Nixon Ball to accept...

tips: Both users must have enough coins in wallet
Coins are held in escrow until bet is resolved
Bets must be manually resolved by participants

commands.name: betlist
commands.longDescription: View all active bets in the server, including pending, active, and recently completed bets.

examples.output:
📋 Active Bets

1. AJ vs Nixon - 🪙 500
   "My team beats yours Week 10"
   Status: Active

2. David vs Mike - 🪙 200
   "First to 100 points this week"
   Status: Pending acceptance
